name: Emaris
summary: Emaris is fully upholstered in rich coffee-toned recycled leather, carrying a quiet strength and timeless presence. The surface is smooth yet characterful, with deep tones that invite touch and add warmth to any interior. Clean lines and sculptural form give it a modern edge, while the craftsmanship speaks of enduring elegance. DC16053
